Quotes.description: My request to you is that you try to follow the authorities there, the GBC, etc co-operate nicely with them. Our movement is based on love and trust, so if we do not cooperate then how is that love and trust? Follow all of the rules and regulations very strictly without deviation.
The nine devotional processes, beginning with sravana and kirtana, can all be attained at once if one simply chants the holy name of the lord offenselesly.

QuickFacts.description: Srila Prabhupada stayed for 9 days at Tehran, Iran.
Srila Prabhupada stayed for 2 days at Tirupati, Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh, India.
Srila Prabhupada stayed for 38 days at Tokyo, Japan.
ASrila Prabhupada stayed for 8 days at Toronto, Ontario, Canada.
Srila Prabhupada visited San Francisco, California, United States on 20th January of 1967 for the first time.
Srila Prabhupada stayed for 3 days at Wardha, Maharashtra, India.
Srila Prabhupada stayed for 6 days at Washington D.C., United States.
Srila Prabhupada stayed for a day in Wheeling, West Virginia, United States.
Srila Prabhupada stayed for 3 days at Zurich, Switzerland.
Srila Prabhupada published his book 'On the Way to Krishna' in 1973.
Srila Prabhupada visited Los Angeles, California, United States on 6th January of 1968 for the first time.
Srila Prabhupada published his book Krishna Consciousness the Matchless Gift in 1974.
Srila Prabhupada published his book Krishna the Reservoir of Pleasure in 1966.
Srila Prabhupada published his book Perfection of Yoga in 1972.
Srila Prabhupada published his book Krishna Consciousness - The Topmost Yoga System in 1970.
Srila Prabhupada published his book Beyond Birth and Death in 1972.
